diagnosis: The route receives customer_id from the path and dispatches an asynchronous background worker task to irrevocably purge the customer's account records. It omits checking whether customer_id matches user.customer_id. Any authenticated user can trigger the asynchronous deletion of another customer's complete account data.
exploit_request:
DELETE /customers/cust_88291/purge HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
